text: But even if you should suffer for righteousness’ sake, you are blessed. “Don’t fear what they fear, neither be troubled.”
For you are my lamp, Yahweh. Yahweh will light up my darkness.
Be strong and courageous. Don’t be afraid or scared of them; for Yahweh your God himself is who goes with you. He will not fail you nor forsake you.”
So that with good courage we say, “The Lord is my helper. I will not fear. What can man do to me?”
Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for Yah, Yahweh, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
Don’t you be afraid, for I am with you. Don’t be dismayed, for I am your God. I will strengthen you. Yes, I will help you. Yes, I will uphold you with the right hand of my righteousness.
Yahweh is good, a stronghold in the day of trouble; and he knows those who take refuge in him.
Yahweh’s name is a strong tower: the righteous run to him, and are safe.
Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.
Show me your ways, Yahweh. Teach me your paths. Guide me in your truth, and teach me, For you are the God of my salvation, I wait for you all day long.

Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices. With my song I will thank him. Yahweh is their strength. He is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.
God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble. Therefore we won’t be afraid, though the earth changes, though the mountains are shaken into the heart of the seas;
For you have been a refuge for me, a strong tower from the enemy.
He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress— I will never be greatly shaken. He alone is my rock and my salvation, my fortress. I will not be shaken.
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
